p1: I build web experiences that feel fast, look intentional, and hold up under pressure. Based in Norway, working across time zones.
p2: My stack leans React — TanStack Query and Router for data-heavy apps, Leaflet when geography matters, Supabase when I need a backend yesterday. I care about the gap between design and code.
p3: Open to new projects, especially with early-stage teams who value craft over checklists.
